profile.headline: Web Developer • Visual Designer
profile.summary: I am a Web Developer and Visual Designer with 12 years of experience applying creative execution and strategy in the digital space. My work focuses on engineering experiences on the web that are human-centered, accessible, impactful, and enduring.  Outside of work I enjoy designing on Illustrator, reading, playing guitar, going on road trips, and spending quality time with friends and family.
